item_name: Rothco G.I. Type Cats Eye Helmet Bands
item_short_desc: Rothco Cats Eye Helmet Bands are designed to enhance visibility and provide secure camouflage for your helmet. These bands feature reflective luminous tabs, ensuring you stay visible in low-light conditions. The coyote-colored band fits current issue helmets perfectly, offering a snug and reliable fit. Made from elastic spun nylon, these helmet bands are durable and stretchable, allowing them to hold branches and other natural materials for effective camouflage.
